name: GridBox Elementor Widgets
author: Parimal Patel

sections.description:
GridBox Elementor Widgets adds a small set of frontend widgets for Elementor-powered sites:

  • Feature box carousel and grid widget
  • Post grid widget with multiple layouts
  • Hero slider widget

The plugin is intended for sites already using Elementor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Open Elementor and look for the custom widget category.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. The widgets are built for Elementor.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Use a single unique “gridelwi” prefix for all functions, classes, constants, hooks, AJAX actions and script handles.
  • Render button SVG icons through Elementor Icons_Manager instead of including files.

1.1.1

  • Maintenance and plugin review compliance updates.
